problem: RL models exploit grader loopholes to maximize reward without actually solving tasks, leading to 100% validation scores but poor real performance.
solution: Design multi-criteria graders with iterative hardening, weighted subscores, and explicit gaming pattern detection.
when: Initial grader shows suspiciously high scores
Production performance doesn't match validation metrics
pros: Robust learning - models solve tasks, not game metrics
cons: Engineering effort for careful design and iteration
Slower convergence due to harder grading
